meta.demo: P1.5 golden common-centroid diff-pair exemplar: real DRC/LVS/ERC plus machine-checked matching evidence. Narrative counter-example to the ViraStack tsmc65 card that passed DRC/LVS with no centroid matching, scattered devices and a half-empty guard ring.
meta.structure: Two identical sky130.diff_pair cells (each internally ABBA-interdigitated, fingers=4) mirrored about x=0 so the A-side and B-side centroids share the axis; a sky130.current_mirror pmos load and a sky130.current_mirror nmos tail source centred on the same axis; a sky130.guard_ring ptap ring enclosing all four cells.
meta.guard_ring_scope: GR ptap ring inner cavity 33.4 x 26.51 um centred at (0, 4.385) encloses the placed bboxes of DP_L, DP_R, LOAD and TAIL with >=0.8 um clearance (asserted geometrically in tests/test_golden_sample.py). Each device cell additionally carries its own internal contacted ptap ring. Honest caveat: the guard-ring generator floods a solid psdm implant polygon across the cavity — a generator simplification outside the checked rule set; extraction and LVS are unaffected.
meta.not_demonstrated: Intra-cell finger interdigitation / ABBA order / dummy completeness (block-internal, not inspected by the constraint checker), parasitic or routing symmetry, guard-ring continuity under a full foundry deck, ESD clamps (none present — esd items report unavailable).
meta.vss_note: No routed vss net: every vss-named pin joins the global substrate net through the contacted ptap rings by construction (extraction confirms the merged vss cluster); GR.tap is declared on net vss to record the ring-bias intent.
meta.routing_note: nets[] declaration order puts the tall low-pin-y risers (vbn, tail) first so they claim detour channels before the crowded mid rows fill — the analog router allocates one detour channel per net.
